title: Garden Snatch Monk on Duty
description: A surreal night scene features a robed monk with a halo and glasses riding a giant cosmic turtle covered in spiral patterns and glowing orbs. The monk holds a glowing green crystal while a yellow bird perches on his shoulder. Behind them swirls a massive galaxy vortex in purple and green, with a warning sign reading 'BEWARE THE GARDEN SNATCH MONK ON DUTY' beside a pond filled with glowing-eyed hands and flowers.

The monk holds a glowing green crystal as a yellow bird perches on his shoulder. Massive swirling galaxy vortex in purple, green and yellow fills the starry sky above mountains and floating crystals.
